visual_appeal: The frame still reads as a flat near-black panel with a hairline, not a gate. Use a 16px 9-slice: 3px iron #141414, 2px bronze lip #8c6a3a, oak face #4a3424 with vertical grain, and 28×28 iron L-straps with 6px rivets #b08d57 inset 8px at every corner.
Title rail should be 36px of oak plus a 6px iron strap and two rivets; interior fill #1c140e at 92% opacity, not #000, so the wood shows.
Make the hero figure 48px #f3e6c8 with a 1px bronze underline. The cyan 1.7 fights the wood/metal palette.
Open card at 120×28, enamel #8e1e1e, top highlight #c45a4a, label #f4ead8. The current red button looks like a stock Blizzard button.
play_next_clarity: Put the #1 disc fully outside the portrait: 40px, fill #c6a15b, numeral 18px #1a1208. It currently clips the bronze ring.
Action bar 44px tall, fill #2a1810, 4px left stripe #3d9a4a, sentence 16px #f4ead8. Rename the button PLAY LE NETTE; Open card does not say what to do.
Replace '1d ahead of Le Beouf (full for 8h)' with 'Most rested · 1 day ahead of Le Beouf' at 14px #e6d7c3 directly under the big number. 'Ahead' is undefined.
Row 2's full green bar is as loud as the hero. Drop list-bar height to 8px and keep only the hero bar at 14px so the eye cannot pick Le Beouf as the next character.
state_colours: Chips are muddy. Lock them: full #1e6b32/#b6f0c4, nearly #6a5a10/#ffe08a, resting #8a3e12/#ffb07a, not resting #7a1c1c/#ff8d8d. RESTING must not sit on theme brown.
Left rail 6px at 100% state color. The 4px rail and 6% row tint disappear on the black rows.
Bars: full #3dbe5a, nearly #e2c15a, resting #e07a2f, not #d64545. Yellow and green are too close at 8px height.
Tint not-resting rows 10% #d64545 so Colonol and Le Bankken scan as red before the chip is read.
character_identity: List portraits are ~28px. Make them 40px, 2px bronze ring #b08d57, 2px inner state ring, class crest 16px sitting 4px outside the ring at 4 o'clock.
The card is a bust pasted on a room photo with a dead center. Build a 220×260 alcove, 2px pedestal line #b08d57, 40px floor shadow, portrait centered on it.
Anchor the speech tail to the mouth with an 8px gap. Hook 18px #f4ead8, fact line 13px #e6d7c3. The bubble currently floats in the top-left void.
Add a 14px class icon beside 'Undead Mage' / 'Troll Hunter'. Class color on the name alone is not enough at roster size.
default_theme: Default chrome is the same dark spreadsheet as ElvUI, minus gold titles. Ship the oak/iron/rivet 9-slice on every top-level frame, including the tip, toast, banner, and empty-state window.
Body text cream #f3e6c8, titles 16px #e6c98a. White titles on the default window break the Gatewood ink.
Blue buttons #1e4f86 and red #9b2c2c, both 26px with a 1px top highlight and bronze edge. Compact still looks like a generic dark button.
Add an 8px iron strap above the footer so the sync line and checkbox sit on a rail, not in empty black.
elvui_wc3_fit: With the skin loaded I still see no planks, straps, or rivets, and default vs ElvUI chrome is almost identical. Confirm S:HandlePortraitFrame is the only frame and leave 10px of padding so the skin edge is not covered.
Titles must use the skin gold #ffd100 at 16px on the skin title plate, matching the guild frame in the user's UI. Scene 02 only tints the title yellow.
Force WC3 enamel: Open card red and at least 96px wide; Compact and Link account blue with end caps. Compact in the ElvUI shot is a plain dark ElvUI button.
Body copy cream #f3e6c8, not pure white. Drop any leftover gold hairline so the skin is the only border.
alerts_ux: Logout banner 440×128, 16px under the logout popup, 6px left stripe #d64545. Headline 16px #ffb4b4: 'Not resting — moving cancels logout'. It currently blends into the logout box.
Used-up toast title and left stripe #e85d5d, not gold. 'RESTED XP USED UP' currently reads as a loot reward.
Esc warning at 16px, 8px above the game menu, and add 'Play Le Nette (full)'. The one-line scold is easy to miss and names no alternative.
Right-click menu 180px wide, 28px rows, same oak surface: 'Dismiss this warning' and 'Disable these warnings'. It is promised and never shown.
readability: Zone and '3d ago' are ~#9a8b78 on black. Raise all secondary type to #e6d7c3 at 13px minimum.
Chip text 12px bold, contrast at least 7:1. RESTING tan-on-brown fails. 'levels banked · 100%' under the hero at 13px #f4ead8, not small gray.
Moons at 16px with an 11px 'RANK' word, not an icon-only header. Chart axis and 'peak 16% of full' at 12–13px #e6d7c3 / #e6c98a.
Now-playing '0.6 of a level of rested XP left' at 14px #f4ead8 beside the OUTSIDE AN INN chip. It is the current-character warning and it is the dimmest line on the panel.
layout_polish: Snap the hero to an 8px grid: portrait left 16px, name block at y=24, 1.7 right-aligned with 16px inset, action sentence and button vertically centered in the 44px bar.
Open-card row needs a visible 2px gold #e6c98a marker. Colonol's row in the docked card shot has none.
Keep an 8px gap between main window and card, equal heights, 12px padding before the chart so tidbit rows don't collide with the plot.
'Acct #3' as an 11px chip #3a2e22/#e6d7c3, not a superscript on the name. Summary icons 14px, 8px gaps, aligned to cap height.
delight: Give every speech bubble a 2px bronze border and a tail; set the hook in the class color at 17px. The flat rectangle kills the voice.
When #1 changes, leave a static 30% #e6c98a sheen on the action bar so the moment still reads in a still screenshot.
Le Nette's chart is a solid green slab. Use a 2px line, 35% area fill, and cream 'Full the whole time' above the fill, not inside it. Dashed baseline #6a5a48 for empty hours, as on the low series.
Empty-state quote belongs in a speech bubble on the portrait, not a beige rectangle. Add a 14px hearth icon on resting rows.

overall_notes: The information design is ahead of the art. Who to play next is legible, the sort and the four states mostly work, and the alerts stay non-modal. It does not yet look like Gatewood: no readable oak, iron, or rivets, default and ElvUI chrome are nearly the same, RESTING is brown-on-brown, and the character card is a floating bust in a dead stage rather than someone talking to you. I would not approve it for a demanding user until the material frame actually shows and the hero action is visually louder than row 2.
